values.note: The Forest Service page contradicts itself: 'Single Site: $15 per night' in the fee table, but 'There is a $12 per-night fee with a fee of $5 for extra vehicles.' in the text (page updated Aug 31, 2026). $5 per extra vehicle.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/steel-creek-campground ('The campground has 7 units. The maximum recommended trailer length for the area is 22 feet.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service Seasons of Use: 'June through September'.
ADA-accessible vault toilets; no garbage service (pack it out). Horses/pack animals allowed.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/steel-creek-campground ('Vault toilet(s)', 'Potable water is available at this site.', 'There is no garbage service', 'Horse/Pack animals are allowed at this site.'), read 2026-10-22

note: In lodgepole pine and Douglas fir with Steel Creek flowing through, ~9 mi up Steel Creek Road north of Wisdom in the Big Hole, Beaverhead-Deerlodge NF (Wisdom RD), a gateway toward the Anaconda-Pintler Wilderness; fishing access. A 22-ft trailer limit fits a 23-ft motorhome; larger rigs tight. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated Aug 31, 2026): confirmed 7 units, first-come, vault toilet, drinking water; added 22-ft max trailer, June-September season. Fee: table says $15, text says $12 (+$5 extra vehicle); recorded $15 left and the conflict noted. Not stated: hookups (derived none left), stay limit. Note trimmed (dropped the unsourced 'one source 25 ft').
flags: Fee conflict on the FS page: 'Single Site: $15 per night' vs 'There is a $12 per-night fee'; the stored $15 was left.
Location: the FS page gives 45.603415,-113.336572, about 0.7 km east of the entry's 45.60100,-113.34500; worth a satellite check of which is the campground.
